status_summary: No NTIA program for short-term leasing of federal spectrum to commercial users was found since 2025-01-20. NTIA's work has followed a reallocation path instead: on 2026-04-14 it announced that relocation plans for the 2.7 GHz band had cleared technical review and were sent to OMB, with the band to move from federal use to full-power commercial licensed use. That approach clears federal users rather than leasing their bands, and the broader spectrum pipeline is tracked in c28-04.
title: Begin short-term temporary leasing of federal spectrum while keeping agency rights

The full NTIA press archive and the Spectrum Sharing Innovation Test-Bed pages were not reviewed. A lease program could exist without press coverage.
